description: Surgical Activity Recognition Podcast Bot - An AI system that analyzes surgical videos and provides interactive Q&A about detected phases, tools, and robotic surgical concepts

vision_pipeline.description: Two-stage vision pipeline for surgical video analysis

stage_1_cnn.purpose: Frame-level feature extraction and dual-task prediction

backbone.description: Pre-trained on ImageNet for transfer learning

tool_detection.description: Detects multiple surgical tools present in each frame

phase_detection.description: Classifies the surgical phase for each frame

stage_2_lstm.purpose: Temporal modeling of surgical phases using CNN features

attention_mechanism.description: Learns to focus on important time steps in the sequence
attention_mechanism.output: Weighted context vector from LSTM outputs

temporal_processing.description: Processes sequences of 16 frames with 8-frame stride, aggregates predictions via voting

advantages.bidirectional: Considers both past and future context
advantages.attention: Focuses on important frames in the sequence
advantages.smoothing: Reduces frame-level noise through temporal aggregation

steps: 1. Extract frames from video at specified sample rate (default: 1 FPS)
2. Pass each frame through CNN to get tool predictions, phase predictions, and 2048-dim features
3. Collect features into sequences of 16 frames with 8-frame stride
4. Pass feature sequences through LSTM with attention for refined phase predictions
5. Aggregate LSTM predictions using confidence-weighted voting
6. Create phase segments by grouping consecutive frames with same phase
7. Map detected tools to each phase segment
inference_pipeline.output_format: NPZ file containing frame indices, timestamps, tool predictions, tool confidences, phase predictions, phase confidences, LSTM actions, LSTM confidences, and features

language_models.description: Three language models for interactive Q&A and narration generation

core_gpt2.name: Fine-tuned GPT-2

fine_tuning.description: LoRA adds trainable low-rank matrices to attention layers, enabling efficient fine-tuning with minimal parameters
advantages: Faster training and lower memory usage
Easy to swap between different LoRA adapters

core_gpt2.training_data: Surgical robotics knowledge base + phase-tool mappings
core_gpt2.specialization: Surgical robotics concepts and technical explanations
core_gpt2.use_case: Primary model for surgical and technical questions

sota_gpt4o.name: GPT-4o
sota_gpt4o.use_case: Best quality responses for complex questions
sota_gpt4o.limitations: Requires API key and internet connection

cholec80.purpose: Training CNN and LSTM for surgical phase and tool recognition

m2cai16_workflow.purpose: Testing and evaluation of phase recognition

dailydialog.description: Multi-turn dialogue dataset for conversational AI
dailydialog.purpose: Training language models for natural conversation
dailydialog.topics: Daily life conversations covering various topics
dailydialog.use: Fine-tuning GPT-2 for conversational abilities and dialogue understanding

surgical_robotics_knowledge.description: Custom knowledge base for surgical robotics concepts
surgical_robotics_knowledge.purpose: Training language model on domain-specific knowledge
surgical_robotics_knowledge.format: JSON files with structured Q&A pairs
surgical_robotics_knowledge.use: Fine-tuning Core GPT-2 model with LoRA

interactive_qa.description: Real-time question-answering system with context awareness

features.context_awareness: Bot receives full video analysis context including phase-to-tools mapping

interactive_qa.model_selection: User can choose dummy/core/sota model via --model-type flag
interactive_qa.output: Conversation saved as JSON in results/final_results/

transfer_learning.description: Using pre-trained ImageNet weights for ResNet-50 backbone
transfer_learning.benefit: Leverages learned visual features, faster convergence, better performance

multi_task_learning.description: CNN simultaneously predicts tools and phases
multi_task_learning.benefit: Shared representations improve both tasks, more efficient than separate models

attention_mechanism.description: LSTM learns to focus on important time steps
attention_mechanism.benefit: Improves temporal modeling by weighting relevant frames higher

lora_peft.how_it_works: Adds trainable low-rank decomposition matrices (A and B) to frozen pre-trained weights: W' = W + BA
lora_peft.parameters: Only ~0.1-1% of original model parameters are trainable
lora_peft.benefit: Efficient fine-tuning without modifying base model weights

sliding_window.description: LSTM processes overlapping windows of 16 frames with 8-frame stride
sliding_window.benefit: Captures temporal context while maintaining computational efficiency

confidence_weighted_voting.description: Aggregates LSTM predictions by weighting votes with confidence scores
confidence_weighted_voting.benefit: More reliable predictions by trusting high-confidence windows more

performance_metrics.description: Performance metrics from M2CAI16 workflow test dataset (5 videos: 1, 4, 6, 12, 14)

cnn_phase_recognition.notes: Frame-level predictions without temporal smoothing. High variance across videos (4.6% to 77.1%)

cnn_tool_detection.notes: Tools evaluated based on expected tools for detected phase

lstm_phase_recognition.notes: Temporal smoothing with attention mechanism significantly improves performance

inference_speed.notes: Tested on Intel CPU with varying video lengths

key_observations.high_variance: Performance varies significantly across videos (4.6% to 91.5%)
key_observations.lstm_benefit: LSTM provides substantial improvement (+28.9% avg) through temporal context
key_observations.best_performance: Video 12 and 14 show strong performance (>89% LSTM accuracy)
key_observations.challenging_videos: Videos 1, 4, 6 show lower accuracy, likely due to unusual surgical variations or lighting
key_observations.tool_detection: Phase-aware tool accuracy ranges from 46.6% to 88.0%

what_i_can_do: Analyze surgical videos to detect phases and tools
Answer questions about detected phases and tools in specific videos
Explain robotic surgical concepts and algorithms
Provide technical details about my own architecture
Generate educational content about surgical robotics
Save conversation history for later review
what_i_cannot_do: Detect phases/tools not in my training data
Provide medical advice or clinical decisions
Access information beyond my knowledge bases

self_awareness.my_architecture: I am a two-stage vision system (CNN + LSTM) combined with language models for Q&A
self_awareness.my_training: My vision models were trained on Cholec80 dataset, my language model was fine-tuned on surgical robotics knowledge
self_awareness.my_purpose: I help users understand surgical videos by detecting what's happening and explaining the robotic concepts involved
self_awareness.my_limitations: I can only detect 7 phases and 7 tools that I was trained on. I cannot provide medical advice.
self_awareness.how_i_work: I first analyze your video frame-by-frame with a CNN, then use an LSTM to understand temporal patterns, then answer your questions using my language model and knowledge bases
